title: RCW 19.28 — Electrical Installation
note: Starter dataset. Verify every answer against current RCW 19.28 text before relying on results for exam prep.

questions.question: Under RCW 19.28, who is primarily responsible for ensuring that all electrical work performed in Washington State complies with applicable codes?
choices: The property owner
The licensed electrical contractor
The local building department
The journeyman electrician on site
questions.explanation: RCW 19.28.061 places primary compliance responsibility on the licensed electrical contractor who performs or supervises the work.

questions.question: Which state agency administers and enforces RCW 19.28?
choices: Washington State Department of Health
Washington State Department of Labor and Industries (L&I)
Washington State Utilities and Transportation Commission
Washington State Building Code Council
questions.answer: Washington State Department of Labor and Industries (L&I)
questions.explanation: RCW 19.28.010 designates the Department of Labor and Industries as the administering and enforcing agency for electrical installation law.

questions.question: An electrical contractor license issued under RCW 19.28 is valid for how long before renewal is required?
choices: 6 months
1 year
2 years
3 years
questions.explanation: Under RCW 19.28.041, electrical contractor licenses are issued on an annual basis and must be renewed each year.

questions.question: Which of the following persons is NOT required to hold an individual electrician's certificate of competency under RCW 19.28?
choices: A journeyman electrician performing commercial wiring
A homeowner doing electrical work on their own single-family residence
A master electrician supervising apprentices
An electrician trainee working on a commercial job
questions.answer: A homeowner doing electrical work on their own single-family residence
questions.explanation: RCW 19.28.261 provides an exemption allowing homeowners to perform electrical work on their own single-family dwelling without an individual certificate, provided they obtain the required permits and inspections.

questions.question: Under RCW 19.28, an electrical permit is generally required before starting most electrical installations. Which of the following is a primary purpose of this permit requirement?
choices: To generate revenue for the state general fund
To allow the local utility to schedule a reconnection
To ensure the work is inspected for compliance with safety codes
To notify neighboring property owners
questions.answer: To ensure the work is inspected for compliance with safety codes
questions.explanation: Permit requirements exist to trigger the inspection process, ensuring that electrical installations meet safety standards before energization.

questions.question: What is the minimum ratio of journey-level electricians to apprentices generally permitted on a job site under Washington electrical law?
choices: 1 journey-level to 1 apprentice
1 journey-level to 2 apprentices
1 journey-level to 3 apprentices
1 journey-level to 4 apprentices
questions.explanation: WAC rules implementing RCW 19.28 generally limit the apprentice ratio to two apprentices per journey-level electrician, though variations exist depending on the type of work and apprenticeship program.

questions.question: Under RCW 19.28, electrical installations must be inspected before they are concealed or energized. Who is authorized to perform these inspections in Washington State?
choices: Only L&I state electrical inspectors
L&I state electrical inspectors, or inspectors from an approved local government inspection program
Any licensed electrical contractor
The installing electrician's supervisor
questions.answer: L&I state electrical inspectors, or inspectors from an approved local government inspection program
questions.explanation: RCW 19.28.321 allows local governments to operate their own electrical inspection programs if approved by L&I, in addition to L&I's own inspectors.

questions.question: An electrical contractor who employs electricians performing work under RCW 19.28 is required to carry which of the following?
choices: Performance bond only
General liability insurance only
Both a surety bond and general liability insurance
Workers' compensation coverage only
questions.answer: Both a surety bond and general liability insurance
questions.explanation: RCW 19.28.041 requires electrical contractors to maintain a surety bond and general liability insurance as conditions of licensure.

questions.question: Which type of electrical work is explicitly exempt from the licensing requirements of RCW 19.28?
choices: Installation of service entrance equipment in a commercial building
Maintenance of electrical equipment by the owner-operator of a manufacturing plant on their own premises
Wiring of a new multi-family residential unit
Installation of a subpanel in a retail space
questions.answer: Maintenance of electrical equipment by the owner-operator of a manufacturing plant on their own premises
questions.explanation: RCW 19.28.006 provides exemptions for certain owner-operator maintenance activities on their own industrial premises, recognizing that plant maintenance staff often perform routine electrical upkeep.

questions.question: Under RCW 19.28, what action can L&I take against an electrical contractor who repeatedly violates the electrical installation law?
choices: Issue a verbal warning only
Suspend or revoke the contractor's electrical contractor license
Refer the matter to the county prosecutor only
Require the contractor to retake the licensing exam
questions.answer: Suspend or revoke the contractor's electrical contractor license
questions.explanation: RCW 19.28.271 grants L&I the authority to suspend or revoke licenses for violations, in addition to other civil and criminal penalties available under the chapter.

questions.question: Which of the following best describes the scope of RCW 19.28?
choices: It applies only to commercial and industrial electrical installations
It applies to all electrical installations in or on all buildings, structures, and premises in Washington State, with limited exceptions
It applies only to new construction and not to remodel work
It applies only to installations involving voltages above 600V
questions.answer: It applies to all electrical installations in or on all buildings, structures, and premises in Washington State, with limited exceptions
questions.explanation: RCW 19.28.010 broadly defines the scope to cover electrical installations statewide, subject to specific exemptions enumerated elsewhere in the chapter.

questions.question: Under RCW 19.28, an electrical trainee certificate is issued to:
choices: Any person who has completed a four-year apprenticeship
A person who is learning the electrical trade and working under the direct supervision of a certified electrician
A licensed contractor who is new to the industry
A master electrician from another state seeking reciprocity
questions.answer: A person who is learning the electrical trade and working under the direct supervision of a certified electrician
questions.explanation: Trainee certificates under RCW 19.28 are designed for individuals entering the trade who must work under supervision while accumulating the hours needed for journey-level certification.

questions.question: If an electrical contractor license expires and the contractor continues to perform electrical work without renewal, they are subject to:
choices: A grace period of 90 days with no penalty
Civil penalties and potential criminal misdemeanor charges under RCW 19.28
Only a late renewal fee with no other consequence
Automatic suspension of their bond only
questions.answer: Civil penalties and potential criminal misdemeanor charges under RCW 19.28
questions.explanation: Operating without a current license violates RCW 19.28 and can result in civil penalties and criminal misdemeanor prosecution per RCW 19.28.151.

questions.question: A master electrician certificate under RCW 19.28 requires the applicant to pass an exam demonstrating knowledge of:
choices: Only the National Electrical Code (NEC)
The NEC and Washington State electrical law and rules
Only Washington State administrative rules
General construction management principles
questions.answer: The NEC and Washington State electrical law and rules
questions.explanation: The master electrician exam tests both NEC knowledge and familiarity with RCW 19.28 and its implementing WAC rules.

questions.question: When a final electrical inspection reveals code violations, who is primarily responsible for correcting the deficiencies?
choices: The property owner
The electrical inspector who conducted the inspection
The licensed electrical contractor who performed the installation
The local building department
questions.answer: The licensed electrical contractor who performed the installation
questions.explanation: The licensed contractor is responsible for the work they perform and must correct any deficiencies identified during inspection before the installation can be approved and energized.
